priorityList: Use Charge to enter combat and Pummel to interrupt enemy spellcasting.
Maintain Sweeping Strikes whenever more than one target is present.
Apply Rend to your primary target if it is not currently active.
Cast Avatar and Champion's Spear as your primary damage cooldowns, ideally synced together.
Use Colossus Smash (or Warbreaker) to apply a damage-taken debuff to the enemy pack.
Cast Ravager while the Colossus Smash debuff is active on your targets.
Use Cleave as your primary Rage spender for multi-target damage and to apply Deep Wounds.
Cast Whirlwind only if you have 3 stacks of Collateral Damage and the Fervor of Battle talent.
Cast Execute if Sudden Death procs or a target is below 20% health (35% if Massacre is talented).
Use Bladestorm while the Colossus Smash debuff is active for high burst AoE.
Use Mortal Strike as a high-priority filler to maintain Deep Wounds if Cleave is unavailable.
Use Thunder Clap to refresh Rend on the pack if it has less than 8 seconds remaining.
Cast Overpower to generate Martial Prowess stacks and fill empty global cooldowns.
Use offensive Racials (like Berserking or Blood Fury) and Potions specifically during the Colossus Smash window.
Use Whirlwind or Slam as a low-priority filler if no other abilities are available and you have excess Rage.
